script_text: Stop! Scorpio, the stars are screaming at you right now. Pluto is forming a tense square to your emotional Moon, forcing buried feelings in your eighth House of intimacy and shared resources into the open tonight. Your ruling Water planet Pluto is activated, so secrets and power struggles may erupt before you choose total transparency. This aspect asks you to feel, not fight, what has been buried, because old wounds will not heal by ignoring them. For love, if you are taken, watch for possessiveness disguised as devotion; if single, attract a magnetic, loyal partner who matches your deep intensity. For career and money, your tenth House of reputation may face a public power clash, so do not make bold financial moves until the truth settles. Avoid revenge fantasies, but an unexpected gift or closure arrives by week's end. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
